import hashlib,json,pathlib,statistics,zipfile
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();out=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent;perf=root/'docs/performance'
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report=read(perf/'chatgpt-keyframe-scalar-production-20261105.json')
assert report['complete']and report['diagnostic_valid']and report['matched_valid']and report['browser_captures']==12
assert report['page_instruction_credit']==report['broad_cadence_after']==0 and not report['broad_required']
focus=read(perf/'chatgpt-keyframe-scalar-20261105.json')
assert focus['focused']['passed']and focus['focused_test_function_executions']==488
assert all(sha(root/p)==h for p,h in focus['focused']['source_after'].items())
diagnostic=read(perf/'chatgpt-keyframe-scalar-production-r1-diagnostic-20261105.json')
matched=read(perf/'chatgpt-keyframe-scalar-production-r1-matched-20261105.json')
for data,count in [(diagnostic,4),(matched,8)]:
    assert data['complete']and data['identity_stable']and len(data['observations'])==count
    assert all(r['exit']==r['kernel_exit_status']==0 and r['content_exact']and r['pixels_exact']for r in data['observations'])
assert sorted((r['variant'],r['paths']['keyframe_scalar'])for r in diagnostic['observations']if r['engine']=='vox')==[('candidate',True),('control',False)]
controls=[r['launch_instruction_interval']for r in matched['observations']if r['variant']=='control']
candidates=[r['launch_instruction_interval']for r in matched['observations']if r['variant']=='candidate']
assert statistics.median(r['upper']for r in controls)==report['control_median']
assert statistics.median(r['upper']for r in candidates)==report['candidate_median']
assert min(r['lower']for r in controls)-max(r['upper']for r in candidates)==report['conservative_page_instruction_reduction']==-658399115
for name in ['run-guard.json','finalize-guard.json']:
    guard=read(out/name);assert guard['reason']=='completed'and guard['child_exit_code']==0
archives=[]
for entry in report['evidence']:
    p=root/entry['path'];assert sha(p)==entry['sha256']and p.stat().st_size==entry['bytes']
    with zipfile.ZipFile(p)as z:
        assert z.testzip()is None
        index=json.loads(z.read('index.json'))
        for name,e in index['entries'].items():
            b=z.read('blobs/'+e['sha256']);assert len(b)==e['bytes']and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==e['sha256'],name
        for name in z.namelist():
            if name.startswith('blobs/'):assert hashlib.sha256(z.read(name)).hexdigest()==name[6:]
    archives.append(entry)
proof=[p for p in (out/'diagnostic').rglob('keyframe-scalar-source-proof.json')]
# The source proof is journaled directly into the diagnostic archive; inspect
# its authenticated entry without requiring a duplicated physical file.
source_proofs=[]
with zipfile.ZipFile(root/diagnostic['evidence']['path'])as z:
    index=json.loads(z.read('index.json'))
    for name,e in index['entries'].items():
        if name.endswith('keyframe-scalar-source-proof.json'):
            p=json.loads(z.read('blobs/'+e['sha256']));assert p['executable_sha256']==report['production']['executable_sha256'];source_proofs.append(p)
assert len(source_proofs)==1
observed_vox=max(r['launch_instruction_interval']['upper']for r in matched['observations']if r['engine']=='vox')
observed_brave=min(r['launch_instruction_interval']['lower']for r in matched['observations']if r['engine']=='brave')
assert 20*observed_vox>19*observed_brave
result=dict(complete=True,archives=archives,source_proofs=source_proofs,finalization_guard=read(out/'finalize-guard.json'),
    source_hashes=focus['focused']['source_after'],valid_render_captures=12,focused_test_function_executions=488,
    page_instruction_credit=0,broad_cadence_after=0,acceptance=False,
    observed_brave_target=dict(max_vox_upper=observed_vox,min_brave_lower=observed_brave,numerator=20*observed_vox,denominator=19*observed_brave,passed=False,minimum_pairs=7,actual_matched_pairs=4),
    qualification='All content/pixel/exit/input gates pass and the separate diagnostic verifies candidate-only execution. Matched ranges overlap; the candidate point median is 0.238796% higher, so no whole-page savings or broad checkpoint is credited. Counts are the observed exclusive-coalition launch-through-encoded-PNG workflow. Four pairs are diagnostic only. Component benefits and the inherited-color regression remain retained. The 5%-below-Brave target remains unmet.')
(perf/'chatgpt-keyframe-scalar-production-verification-20261105.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(complete=True,archives_verified=len(archives),valid_captures=12,focused_calls=488,page_credit=0)))
